user.title: Set up Nimbus
user.description: This creates the Nimbus hub. You'll add each load you want forecast (HWS, EV charger, pool, individual circuit breakers -- as many as you like) afterward from the hub's own device page, one at a time, without repeating this setup.

abort.already_configured: Nimbus is already set up -- add loads from its device page instead of adding it again.

user.title: Add a load
user.description: Pick the power sensor this load should learn from. Everything below the sensor pickers is optional and already has a sensible default.
